description: Na₂CuC₂H₆O₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 78°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of edge and face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.41 Å. Cu is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Cu-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.30 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.25-1.32 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.26-1.31 Å. There are six inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.71 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.71 Å) H-O bond length. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.98 Å) and one longer (1.72 Å) H-O bond length. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one Cu, and two H atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Cu, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Cu, one C, and one H atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one C, and one H atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Cu, one C, and one H atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Cu and one C atom.
